name: polymarket-mcp
description: Polymarket (public markets) (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker. Every tool maps to a documented

tools.name: me
tools.description: Public API, no credentials: GET /status answers OK.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Open markets, paged with limit/offset; `query` is not sent. `symbol` is the market slug get_ticker takes; outcomes, outcomePrices and clobTokenIds are JSON-encoded strings.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: `symbol` is a market slug. Prices are probabilities (0-1) for the market's FIRST outcome (usually Yes); the other outcome trades near 1 - price.
